01 / BRAKE BEFORE THE CORNER. Brake on the straight, then turn in smoothly. Enable the driving guide in race setup if you need help finding the line.

02 / MAKE YOUR MOVE. Follow a rival closely on straights for a slipstream. Hold Shift to deploy ERS; lift off or brake to recharge.

03 / KEEP IT CLEAN. Street walls and rivals slow you down. Complete every sector to count a lap. Press V for a clean, frozen photo view; press V again to resume.

Gamepad supported: left stick to steer, RT to accelerate, LT to brake, A for ERS, Y for camera. On mobile, slide the left pad to steer. Hold GAS and slide up for ERS; release to coast. Move to BRAKE to slow down. Race in landscape.
